title: Transform labels and handle an empty result
instructions: Implement cleanLabels: trim each input label, keep labels of length at least four, and return them in case-sensitive natural sorted order. Preserve duplicates. Inputs and elements are non-null.
Implement firstLabel using Optional: return the first cleaned label, or Optional.empty() if there is none. Do not call get() without establishing presence.
